candidate_rule: all INA speech-to-music returns satisfying the frozen detector rules and corroborated by Silero

transcription.scope: every automatically detected candidate, including candidates below the anchor confidence threshold

interpretation.known_input: artist and title strings only, without timestamps

strict_under_threshold_alternative.title_requirement: exactly one exact main-title phrase in the untimed known tracklist
strict_under_threshold_alternative.relation_requirement: explicit incoming-track cue; weak 'and now' additionally requires presentational 'this is'
strict_under_threshold_alternative.identity_requirement: artist evidence and, for remix titles, named variant evidence or explicit possessive remix

non_retuning_statement: All parameters above are frozen before loading FYH512 reference timestamps; no YouTube-score retuning is permitted.
